# Rodrigo Blanco

> Rodrigo Blanco is the founder and CEO of TerraFunded, a Dallas company that sells rural Texas land directly to buyers with owner financing. 350+ land transactions and $15M+ in sales.

Rodrigo Blanco is the founder and CEO of TerraFunded, a Dallas-based company that sells rural Texas land directly to buyers with owner financing. He built it together with his wife and co-founder, Luisa de Blanco.

## Facts
- Full name: Rodrigo Blanco Marroquín
- Role: Founder & CEO, TerraFunded, LLC
- Co-founder: Luisa de Blanco, his wife
- Office: 3838 Oak Lawn Avenue, Suite 1000, Dallas, TX 75219
- Focus: Owner-financed rural land in Texas
- Languages: English and Spanish
- TerraFunded founded: 2020, with Luisa de Blanco
- Track record: 350+ land transactions and $15M+ in cumulative land sales (April 2026, reported by The Title Report)
- About 40% of TerraFunded buyers are Hispanic or Latino
- Portafolio Diversificado (co-founded 2019, residential real estate) is a separate company from TerraFunded, LLC
